submission.reasoning: An interactive cmd.exe (proc-23dc9b1636) running as WORKSTATION5\wardog with High integrity wrote a file, most likely the batch payload C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat. It then started reg.exe (proc-55d9f85e37) to run 'REG ADD HKCU\Environment /v UserInitMprLogonScript /d ...\Temp\art.bat /f'. That sets a logon-script persistence value (T1037.001): the batch file will run every time this user logs on. The setup matches an Atomic Red Team style persistence test, but the persistence is real and has to be removed.
